title: The World Remembers
phases: The ground keeps what people do.
Paths, notes, and deaths have begun to overlap here.
You have learned to read—and leave—the world’s memory.

title: A Life Becomes Capable
phases: A life can grow in directions the body remembers.
This life has begun to take a shape of its own.
Death ends a build, but not everything a life leaves behind.

title: Feast Before the Journey
phases: Food can be stored intention.
A prepared body can do more than a merely fed one.
You have felt reserves become performance—and debt.

title: Stone Makes Promises
phases: Stone tells you what it wants to become.
You can read a deposit before you know its assay.
Simple geology has opened into dirty chemistry.

title: Materials Have Temperaments
phases: A material is a behaviour, not a tier.
Your tools have begun to carry a temperament.
You are choosing matter for the way it acts.

title: Motion Becomes Industry
phases: Rotation is labour waiting to be arranged.
One motion now performs work on your behalf.
Your factory has begun to move itself.

title: A Vessel Can Become a Place
phases: A boat can be built instead of crafted.
You have the beginnings of a place that floats.
The world now has coastlines instead of walls.

title: Rails Turn Distance into Machinery
phases: A railway is one machine stretched across distance.
Stations and signals can make motion deliberate.
Distance has become part of your factory.

title: Pressure Changes Matter
phases: Pressure is a reagent.
You can contain forces ordinary crafting wastes.
Matter has begun to change behind sealed walls.

title: Machines Can Remember
phases: Storage can become memory; memory can become action.
Your network has begun to know what it contains.
Machines can now remember and decide for you.

title: Doors Borrow Other Worlds
phases: Some doors borrow another world and must give it back.
You found an aperture that spends charge instead of keys.
You crossed somewhere temporary and returned on purpose.

title: Flight Must Be Engineered
phases: Flight is a materials problem before it is freedom.
You can make lift, but not yet trust it.
The sky has become an engineered place.

title: An Army Walks Toward You
phases: An army can approach before it exists.
Pressure is gathering beyond the loaded horizon.
You watched a route become a raid.

title: Leave the Atmosphere
phases: The atmosphere is a machine you can eventually leave.
Your industry has begun to manufacture survival beyond air.
You have made another world into a destination.

title: Blood Can Become Infrastructure
phases: Life can be made into infrastructure.
You built a place where sacrifice persists as power.
Blood now moves through systems larger than a spell.

title: Reality Has Grammar
phases: Reality has grammar.
You can compose effects instead of merely finding them.
The language admits sentences the world resists.

title: Spirits Honour Contracts
phases: Not every power obeys the same kind of request.
You found a place where one tradition will answer.
You know pacts, spirits, cauldrons, and command are different authorities.

title: A World Can Be Inherited
phases: A world can be finished without being discarded.
You found the machine that asks what should survive.
This world is one generation in a longer inheritance.
